title: neottianthe calcicola
intro: Neottianthe calcicola, commonly known as the alpine slipper orchid, is a rare and endangered species of orchid native to the Himalayas. It is valued for its potential medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Neottianthe calcicola include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. However, due to insufficient research, the therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents of this plant are not well documented.
